purpose: Correct the v2 method-order imbalance without changing the frozen model, inputs, solver caps, or treatment.

timing.solver_call_wall_seconds: from immediately before solver call to immediately after solver returns
timing.full_verified_wall_seconds: from immediately before solver call to after independent Fraction objective and witness verification
excludes: parent JSON parsing and output write
timing.interpretation: solver-plus-verifier wall time, not process-launch-to-output end-to-end time

classification.solver_objective_match: independent selected-set objective equals solver-reported objective
classification.solver_objective_missing: independent selected-set objective computed but solver objective is absent
classification.solver_objective_mismatch: independent selected-set objective differs from solver-reported objective
classification.no_selected_solution: no selected set is available for independent verification

decision_rule: Use v3 only to correct order-bias interpretation; preserve v1/v2 raw evidence and do not claim causal speedup or a new algorithm.
